start.text: Banni, banni! Idli-vada ₹60, masala dosa ₹80, filter coffee ₹20. Token at the counter, eat standing.

idli.text: Hot hot. Chutney free, sambar refill free. Eat, eat.

dosa.text: Crispy one for you. Butter is ₹10 extra — free today, new face.

coffee.text: Strong, ah? Decoction is from five o'clock morning.

bye.text: Okay. Come for breakfast — seven o'clock idli is the best idli.
